segments.he: השלמה למאמרמען עסט עוום איסט וכו'
segments.en: Rabbainu said: "Azmen po'elt nor mit gutn — un az es dukht zikh azmen hot mit baysn ku gep'oylt, zol men visn az mit gutn volt men asakh mer gep'oylt" [One accomplishes only with goodness — and if it seems that one accomplished something through harshness, one should know that through goodness one would have accomplished far more].
